payload.credit_html: "Getting to the root of it: perspectives on the phylogenetic origins of modern reptiles"
payload.description_html: Selected Permo-Triassic neodiapsid fossils representing some of the main taxonomic groups. A, Younginidae (Scyllacerta creanae: SAM-PK-K7710, Iziko South African Museum, Cape Town, South Africa); B, Drepanosauromorpha (Mirasaura grauvogeli: SMNS 97278, Staatliches Museum für Naturkunde Stuttgart, Stuttgart, Germany); C, Ichthyosauromorpha (Cartorhynchus lenticarpus: AGB6257, Anhui Geological Museum, Hefei, China; photo credit: Wei Wang); D, early-diverging member of Sauropterygomorpha (Eusaurosphargis dalsassoi: PIMUZ A/III 4380, Paläontologisches Institut und Museum der Universität Zürich, Zurich, Switzerland; photo credit: PIMUZ); E, Thalattosauria (Askeptosaurus italicus: PIMUZ T 4831; photo credit: PIMUZ); F, early-diverging member of Sauropterygomorpha (Helveticosaurus zollingeri: PIMUZ T 4352; photo credit: PIMUZ); G, early Sauropterygia (Atopodentatus unicus: IVPP V20291, Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology, Beijing, China; photo credit: Wei Wang).
